title: Who actually pays a tariff?
hook_variants: A tariff is a tax on another country, right? Wrong.
Everyone thinks China pays the tariff. Watch who actually pays.
The tariff is on the import. The bill is on you.

scenes.say: A tariff is a tax on another country, right? Wrong.
Here's what really happens when a box hits the border.
A factory abroad sells a toaster to an American importer. The ship lands. Customs stops it.
The toaster costs twenty dollars. A twenty-five percent tariff adds five. And the importer pays it, not the factory.
Then the importer raises the price. So who pays in the end? Mostly, the shopper.
A tariff is a tax. It's just collected at the border, from your side.
Follow for the money stuff nobody explains.

caption:
A tariff is paid by the IMPORTER at the border, not by the foreign country. Then guess who the cost gets passed to... 🧾
